title: Inga Ruginienė becomes prime minister of Lithuania
fact: Inga Ruginienė is a Lithuanian trade unionist and politician serving as Minister of Social Security and Labour since 2026.

title: Gitanas Nausėda becomes president of Lithuania
fact: Gitanas Nausėda is a Lithuanian politician, economist, and banker who is serving as the ninth and incumbent president of Lithuania since 2019.

title: Augustus III of Poland becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Augustus III was King of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1733 until 1763, as well as Elector of Saxony in the Holy Roman Empire where he was known as Frederick Augustus II.

title: Casimir IV Jagiellon becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Casimir IV was Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1440 and King of Poland from 1447 until his death in 1492.

title: Mindaugas becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Mindaugas was the first known Grand Duke of Lithuania and the only crowned King of Lithuania.

title: Vytautas becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Vytautas the Great was a ruler of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, first as regent for his cousin Jogaila (1392–1401) and then as the Grand Duke alongside him (1401–1430).

title: Antanas Smetona becomes president of Lithuania
fact: Antanas Smetona was a Lithuanian intellectual, journalist, and politician.

title: Valdas Adamkus becomes president of Lithuania
fact: Valdas Adamkus is a Lithuanian politician, diplomat and civil engineer and an American civil servant.

title: Dalia Grybauskaitė becomes president of Lithuania
fact: Dalia Grybauskaitė is a Lithuanian politician who served as the eighth president of Lithuania from 2009 to 2019.

title: Algirdas becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Algirdas was Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1345 to 1377.

title: Gintautas Paluckas becomes prime minister of Lithuania
fact: Gintautas Paluckas is a Lithuanian politician who was the 18th prime minister of Lithuania from December 2024 until his resignation on 4 August 2025.

title: Ingrida Šimonytė becomes prime minister of Lithuania
fact: Ingrida Šimonytė is a Lithuanian politician, public servant and economist who served as the 17th prime minister of Lithuania from 2020 to 2024.

title: Andrius Kubilius becomes prime minister of Lithuania
fact: Andrius Kubilius is a Lithuanian politician who is currently serving as the European Commissioner for Defence and Space in the Second von der Leyen Commission.

title: Kęstutis becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Kęstutis was the sole Duke of Trakai from 1342 to 1382 and Grand Duke of Lithuania, believed to rule together with his brother Algirdas, and with his nephew Jogaila.

title: Algirdas Brazauskas becomes president of Lithuania
fact: Algirdas Mykolas Brazauskas was the fourth president of Lithuania, in office from 1993 to 1998.

title: Rolandas Paksas becomes prime minister of Lithuania
fact: Rolandas Paksas is a Lithuanian politician who served as the sixth President of Lithuania from 2003 until his impeachment in April 2004.

title: Algirdas Butkevičius becomes prime minister of Lithuania
fact: Algirdas Butkevičius is a Lithuanian politician and was Prime Minister of Lithuania, serving between 2012 and 2016.

title: Saulius Skvernelis becomes prime minister of Lithuania
fact: Saulius Skvernelis is a Lithuanian politician and activist who served as prime minister of Lithuania between 2016 and 2020.

title: Kazys Grinius becomes prime minister of Lithuania
fact: Kazys Grinius was the third President of Lithuania, holding the office from 7 June 1926 to 17 December 1926.

title: Švitrigaila / Svidrigiello becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Švitrigaila was Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1430 to 1432.

title: Augustinas Voldemaras becomes prime minister of Lithuania
fact: Augustinas Voldemaras was a Lithuanian nationalist political figure.

title: Sigismund Kęstutaitis becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Sigismund Kęstutaitis was Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1432 to 1440.

title: Butvydas becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Butvydas or Pukuveras was Grand Duke of Lithuania from c. 1290 until his death in c.

title: Traidenis becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Traidenis was Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1269 or 1270 until 1282.

title: Vytenis becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Vytenis was Grand Duke of Lithuania from c. 1295 to c.

title: Wojsiełk becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Vaišvilkas or Vaišelga was Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1264 until his death in 1267.

title: Treniota becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Treniota was Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1263 to 1264.

title: Kazimira Prunskienė becomes prime minister of Lithuania
fact: Kazimira Danutė Prunskienė is a Lithuanian politician who was the first prime minister of Lithuania after the declaration of independence on 11 March 1990, and then Minister of Agriculture in the government of Gediminas Kirkilas.

title: Butigeidis becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Butigeidis was Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1285 to 1290 or 1291.

title: Aleksandras Stulginskis becomes president of Lithuania
fact: Aleksandras Stulginskis was the second President of Lithuania (1920–1926).

title: Jaunutis becomes Grand Duke of Lithuania
fact: Jaunutis was Grand Duke of Lithuania after his father Gediminas died in 1341 until he was deposed by his elder brothers Algirdas and Kęstutis in 1345.

title: Artūras Paulauskas becomes president of Lithuania
fact: Artūras Paulauskas is a Lithuanian politician who was Speaker of Seimas, the parliament of Lithuania, from 2000 to 2006.

title: Gediminas Kirkilas becomes prime minister of Lithuania
fact: Gediminas Kirkilas was a Lithuanian politician who was Prime Minister of Lithuania from 2006 to 2008.
